events.body:
## Summary
`m_mirrorSyncTimer` fires every 5 seconds and calls `autoSyncMirrorsIfRelayHealthy()` -> `autoSyncMirrors()` -> `reattestStalePins()`. `reattestStalePins()` ends with an **unconditional full catalog list GET** (`m_networkAccess->get(QNetworkRequest(catalogListUrl()))`, MainWindowChat.cpp) with no throttle, no in-flight guard and no conditional request. That single call is the largest consumer of this project's Cloudflare request budget.

Its own neighbouring comment calls it "the 15-minute reattestStalePins tick" (MainWindowChat.cpp:7876) -- so the 5-second cadence is not the intended design, it is collateral from the mirror timer being sped up.

## Measured (one desktop node, 194 minutes)
| endpoint | requests | per min | projected/day |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/api/repositories` | 3156 | 16.3 | ~23,400 |
| `/api/chat/channels/<id>/history` | 1242 | 6.4 | ~9,200 |
| `/api/accounts/<name>` | 730 | 3.8 | ~5,400 |
| `/api/chat/channels` | 391 | 2.0 | ~2,900 |
| `/api/sync` (the one that delivers work) | 19 | 0.1 | ~140 |
| **total** | **5632** | **29.0** | **~41,800** |

`/api/repositories` is **56% of all egress**; `/api/sync` is 0.34%. Catalog GETs land every ~5s, matching the timer exactly. The free plan allows 100k requests/day for the whole site, and there are 22 mirrors each running their own timer.

## Root cause
`kMirrorSyncIntervalMs` (MainWindowInternal.h) went 5 min -> 60 s -> **5 s**:
- `83b3f018a` "fix(mirrors): converge public nodes within seconds" (2026-08-03 03:13) cut 60s -> 5s
- `4ea041228` "fix(qt): retry mirror convergence every five seconds" then retargeted the source-convergence throttle from a fixed 60s to `kMirrorSyncIntervalMs`, inheriting 5s

Fast mirror convergence is a reasonable goal, but the tick now also drives pin re-attestation and its catalog fetch, which do not need second-level latency.

## Suggested direction
- Give `reattestStalePins()` its own cadence (the documented 15 minutes) independent of the mirror tick, plus an in-flight guard.
- Make the pin check use a cheap conditional/targeted read instead of the full catalog list, or reuse the catalog the node already fetched for its publish.
- Keep the 5s cadence only for the git-side convergence that actually needs it.

## Acceptance criteria
- A steady-state node with no local changes issues no more than a few `/api/repositories` requests per minute.
- Mirror convergence latency does not regress.
- A regression test pins the reattest cadence so a future mirror-timer change cannot inherit it again.

---
_Filed by Claude Code from the 2026-08-03 relay-quota investigation (node `jett`, 194-minute network_log window 11:42:43-14:57:00)._
events.title: Mirror tick at 5s makes reattestStalePins re-fetch the whole catalog 12x/min
